## Example

**Request:**

```http
GET /api/view/activealerts/C8458?lastChanged=2025-12-22T16:08:23Z
Accept: application/json
ae_s: *WPOMs1+UDquA3lmqjIlKm9mGjr7uixpBspy0HA==
ae_v: c75711
referer: https://apps.alsoenergy.com/powertrack/C8458/overview/sites
```
